en.title: IRS launches new mobile app, expanding digital services for taxpayers
en.summary: The IRS today announced the launch of the new IRS mobile app, replacing IRS2Go and expanding the agency’s digital services to give taxpayers more ways to securely access IRS tools and account services from their mobile devices.

en.title: Treasury, IRS update retirement plan correction program and establish correction program for individual retirement accounts
en.summary: The Department of the Treasury and the Internal Revenue Service today issued two revenue procedures that update the correction program for employee retirement plans and create one for Individual Retirement Accounts.

en.title: IRS reminder: Take steps now to protect tax information
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service today reminded taxpayers to protect their information from tax-related identity theft by safeguarding their IRS online-account credentials and obtaining an Identity Protection PIN.

es.title: El IRS lanza nueva aplicación móvil y amplía servicios digitales para contribuyentes
es.summary: El IRS anunció hoy el lanzamiento de la nueva aplicación móvil IRS, la cual reemplaza a IRS2Go y amplía los servicios digitales de la agencia para ofrecer a los contribuyentes más formas de acceder de manera segura a las herramientas y servicios de cuenta del IRS desde sus dispositivos móviles.

es.title: Treasury, IRS update retirement plan correction program and establish correction program for individual retirement accounts
es.summary: The Department of the Treasury and the Internal Revenue Service today issued two revenue procedures that update the correction program for employee retirement plans and create one for Individual Retirement Accounts.

es.title: IRS reminder: Take steps now to protect tax information
es.summary: The Internal Revenue Service today reminded taxpayers to protect their information from tax-related identity theft by safeguarding their IRS online-account credentials and obtaining an Identity Protection PIN.
